Hypothesis Evolution Protocol
Figure 1 presents an overview of the proposed HEP. An LLM agent tackling a research task
interacts with its experimental environment and any other tools as usual. On top of this ordinary
workflow, HEP provides the layer through which the agent manages its hypotheses, evidence,
and beliefs (Fig. 1a). The protocol consists of two components: an auditableHEP Registryand a
set ofHEP Tools. The HEP Registry records each hypothesis as a persistent object with a unique
hypothesis id, carrying a natural-language statement, a belief𝑃(𝐻), defined as the probability
the agent currently assigns to the hypothesis being true, a lifecycle state, and its provenance.
Every belief update, evidence attachment, and state transition is appended to the event log of the
corresponding hypothesis, so the full history of each hypothesis remains auditable to both the
agent and the

Hypothesis Evolution Protocol
Figure 1 presents an overview of the proposed HEP. An LLM agent tackling a research task
interacts with its experimental environment and any other tools as usual. On top of this ordinary
workflow, HEP provides the layer through which the agent manages its hypotheses, evidence,
and beliefs (Fig. 1a). The protocol consists of two components: an auditableHEP Registryand a
set ofHEP Tools. The HEP Registry records each hypothesis as a persistent object with a unique
hypothesis id, carrying a natural-language statement, a belief𝑃(𝐻), defined as the probability
the agent currently assigns to the hypothesis being true, a lifecycle state, and its provenance.
Every belief update, evidence attachment, and state transition is appended to the event log of the
corresponding hypothesis, so the full history of each hypothesis remains auditable to both the
agent and the

evidence.excerpt:
We evaluate HEP on three materials-science research tasks, each posing an open research ques-
tion of the same form: "which crystal structure does a single fixed machine-learned interatomic
potential (MLIP) prefer for each compound in a family, and what physics or chemistry explains
the pattern?" Task AO2 concerns polymorph selection among seven prototypes in the AO2 diox-
ides; task A2BB′O6 concerns B-site cation ordering in the A2BB′O6 double perovskites, among
rock-salt, layered, and columnar orderings and a disordered reference; and task MX concerns
prototype selection among rocksalt, NiAs, zincblende, and wurtzite in the MX transition-metal
monochalcogenides and monopnictides.
The three families span combinatorial complexity from binary (AO 2, MX) to quaternary
(A2BB′O6)compounds,andthequestionstheyposedemandexplanationratherthanoptimization

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported findings closely align with the collected empirical data: hypothesis trees, state transitions, belief flips, and performance variations across base models are corroborated by quantitative logs and state-transition probability matrices [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0017, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0020, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0022, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0028].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation across three distinct materials-science crystal structure prediction tasks demonstrates that the HEP agent traverses the hypothesis-test-evidence-belief cycle, contrasting sharply with a planning-style baseline that spends 0% of its steps updating beliefs [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0013, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0019, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0020]. An ablation comparing base LLMs confirms that protocol utilization depth scales systematically with model reasoning capability [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0028, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0029].
primary.limitations: The authors explicitly acknowledge that evidence validity currently relies on single-agent self-assessment, that the discovered governing rules reflect the behavior of a fixed MLIP rather than DFT or experimental physical reality, and that weaker LLMs struggle to manage complex hypothesis lineages [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0026, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0029, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0032].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is clearly defined: the registry maintains explicit belief probabilities P(H), provenance, lifecycle states, and gating rules where belief updates and terminal verdicts (supported >= 0.8, refuted <= 0.2) require validated evidence attachments [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0011, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0012, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0035, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0036]. The agent loop and its atomistic materials tool environment are systematically documented [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0037, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0038].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents an inventive, soundly implemented framework for scientific LLM auditing with solid experimental controls, clear baselines, and honest discussion of boundaries, meeting library standards for a pass.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces the Hypothesis Evolution Protocol (HEP), an agent harness featuring an append-only event-sourced registry and tool interface that externalizes scientific hypothesis generation, evaluation, belief tracking, and evolution for LLM agents [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0007, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0010, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0034].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents an inventive, soundly implemented framework for scientific LLM auditing with solid experimental controls, clear baselines, and honest discussion of boundaries, meeting library standards for a pass.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly acknowledge that evidence validity currently relies on single-agent self-assessment, that the discovered governing rules reflect the behavior of a fixed MLIP rather than DFT or experimental physical reality, and that weaker LLMs struggle to manage complex hypothesis lineages [E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0026, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0029, E269bb07cb3e53c1a-B0032].

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
